description: This file defines a generic interface 'EntityPopulator' used for converting or copying data from a source object to a target object, possibly involving a MerchantStore context. It declares methods for populating entities from source data, potentially for use in data transformation or persistence layers.

classes.name: EntityPopulator
classes.description: A generic interface for populating target entities from source data, with optional context involving a MerchantStore.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Converts source data into a target entity, optionally utilizing MerchantStore context, may throw ConversionException.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Converts source data into a target entity without additional context, may throw ConversionException.
